manifest.name: dsh-family-budget
manifest.description: Family monthly budget planner in the DSH Web UI: income, fixed and variable expenses, savings, emergency fund, debt and a monthly review, stored per month. Organises household money only and gives no investment advice.
manifest.author: skyline66

bundle.text:
# dsh-family-budget bundle patch.
# The Host half keeps the durable budget document (one JSON file) and serves
# `/family-budget/api/*`. The Client half adds the sidebar entry and the
# monthly budget page.
- insert:
    - id: family-budget
      name: dsh-family-budget
      config:
        root: !!js dshHomePath('family-budget')

readme.section: dsh-family-budget · 家庭财务整理助手
readme.text:
A monthly household budget page for the DSH Web UI: a sidebar entry opens one table
per month with income, fixed expenses, variable expenses, savings, an emergency fund,
debt and a review block. It adds up what you enter, shows the gaps to your own
savings / debt / down-payment target, and keeps every month on disk.

**It is bookkeeping, not advice.** No market data, no products, no forecasts, no
investment suggestions — the page says so itself.

| Block | What you enter | What the page computes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 收入 Income | 工资、奖金、其他进项 | 收入合计，占各比例的基数 |
| 固定支出 Fixed | 房贷／房租、水电燃气、通讯、保险、教育 | 固定支出合计，占收入比例 |
| 可变支出 Variable | 每项的预算与实际 | 预算合计、实际合计、逐项差额、超支项 |
| 储蓄 Savings | 计划储蓄、已累计储蓄 | 本月可存（结余）、距计划差额、一键记入累计 |
| 应急金 Emergency fund | 现有应急金、目标月数（3/6/12） | 目标金额 = 固定支出 × 月数，覆盖率与缺口 |
| 债务 Debt | 每笔余额、月供、本月已还 | 余额合计、月供合计、已还合计 |
| 复盘 Review | 做得好的／超支原因／下月调整 | 自动核对：储蓄率、超支项、固定支出占比、应急金覆盖 |

The goal bar switches between **储蓄 / 还债 / 买房** and tracks one target with an
accumulated amount you control.

Add it from **Settings → Plugins → Add** with the repository spec:

```
github:skyline66/dsh-family-budget
```

Or take the prebuilt `dsh-family-budget.tgz` from the
[releases page](https://github.com/skyline66/dsh-family-budget/releases/latest).
Either way, reload the window afterwards and open the **家庭财务 / Family budget**
entry in the sidebar.

The package is not on npm, so a bare `dsh-family-budget` name will not resolve.

- Everything is kept in one document under `<dsh home>/family-budget/budget.json`.
- The Host half validates every write: unknown keys are dropped, amounts are
  clamped to non-negative numbers rounded to cents, month keys must be `YYYY-MM`,
  review prose is capped, and an unreadable file is moved aside instead of being
  overwritten.
- Nothing leaves the machine. The page talks only to its own plugin route.
- Export CSV for a spreadsheet, export/import JSON for a backup. The import is
  confirmed in the page before it replaces the document.

Displayed amounts use a `¥` prefix as a formatting convention only; the plugin
does not convert currencies.

```sh
npm test        # arithmetic + module wiring (no browser needed)
npm run test:api -- http://127.0.0.1:57253   # live Host round-trip against a running Harness
```

`test/calc.test.mjs` evaluates the exact arithmetic block from `client.js`, so the
shipped maths is what gets tested. `test/wiring.test.mjs` loads `client.js` through
the module loader, applies the plugin to a stub context and checks both slot
registrations plus zh/en dictionary parity. `test/api.test.mjs` POSTs a hostile
document at the live route, checks the cleaned result, and restores the previous
document.

```
index.js            Host half: /family-budget/api/{doc,health}, validation, atomic write
client.js           Client half: sidebar entry + budget page (plain JS, React from the host)
locale/{en,zh}.json plugin title and description for the plugin list
cordis.patch.yml    the bundle row and its storage root
